title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression models the probability that a binary response variable equals $$1$$ as a function of a continuous predictor variable. The model is represented by the logistic function.

title: Logistic Function Formula
text: The logistic function is given by the formula: $$P(Y=1|x)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-b0-b1 x\right)}}$$.

title: Sketching the Logistic Curve
text: Sketch the logistic curve to visualize how the probability changes with different values of $$x$$. The curve is S-shaped, starting near $$0$$, increasing, and leveling off near $$1$$.

title: Calculating $$P(Y=1|x=1)$$
text: Substitute $$x=1$$ into the logistic function formula to find $$P(Y=1|x=1)$$.

title: Interpreting the Result
text: The value you calculated represents the probability that the response variable equals $$1$$ when the predictor variable is $$1$$.
